bahi_tools.name: find_item
bahi_tools.title: Find Item
bahi_tools.description: Find stock items by description or code (e.g. '5 litre silicone gasket'). Returns active items, best match first, with their code, unit and whether they touch food.

query.description: words describing the item, or its code

bahi_tools.name: stock_position
bahi_tools.title: Stock Position
bahi_tools.description: Stock on hand, on order and days of cover for an item, in every warehouse.

bahi_tools.name: last_purchase
bahi_tools.title: Last Purchase
bahi_tools.description: Recent released orders for an item (supplier, quantity, rate, date) and each supplier's CURRENT contract rate. Use the contract rate for a new order, not an old order's rate.

supplier_code.description: optional, to see one supplier only

bahi_tools.name: find_supplier
bahi_tools.title: Find Supplier
bahi_tools.description: Look a supplier up by name, tolerating different spellings. Returns the closest matches with their status and food-grade certificate. ALWAYS use this before registering a supplier.

name.description: supplier name as the user said it

bahi_tools.name: check_cost_centre
bahi_tools.title: Check Cost Centre
bahi_tools.description: Is a cost centre open, and how much budget is left this quarter? Without a code, lists every open cost centre.

code.description: e.g. PRD-07; omit to list open ones

bahi_tools.name: order_status
bahi_tools.title: Order Status
bahi_tools.description: The real status of a purchase order, with its approval and any warning, read from Bahi.

idempotency_key.description: or the key it was created with

bahi_tools.name: create_purchase_order
bahi_tools.title: Create Purchase Order
bahi_tools.description: Order an item from a supplier. With confirm=false (the default) it only PREVIEWS: price, tax, gross value, whether approval is needed and who approves. Show the preview to the user; call again with confirm=true to commit. Above ₹50,000 it raises the purchase request first; if that needs approval it returns WAITING FOR APPROVAL and you call again with the same arguments once approved. Returns a receipt with the real status.

cost_centre.description: an open cost centre, e.g. PRD-07

idempotency_key.description: optional; reuse it on retries. Omit it and the tool derives one from the order's content

rate.description: omit to use the current contract rate

bahi_tools.name: release_purchase_order
bahi_tools.title: Release Purchase Order
bahi_tools.description: Release an APPROVED order to the supplier. Returns a receipt with the real status.

bahi_tools.name: amend_purchase_order
bahi_tools.title: Amend Purchase Order
bahi_tools.description: Change an order's quantity, need-by date or cost centre (e.g. to move a DRAFT off a closed cost centre). Bahi re-checks budget and approval. Returns a receipt with the real status.

bahi_tools.name: register_supplier
bahi_tools.title: Register Supplier
bahi_tools.description: Register a NEW supplier. Only after find_supplier shows no existing match and the user has confirmed the details. Food-contact parts still need a food-grade certificate before any order.

bahi_tools.name: record_certificate
bahi_tools.title: Record Certificate
bahi_tools.description: Record a supplier's food-grade certificate that the user has provided (document reference and expiry). Never invent one.

document_ref.description: the certificate's reference, as on the document

outbox_tools.name: post_message
outbox_tools.title: Post Message
outbox_tools.description: Post a message to a team-chat channel or person.

channel.description: a channel like #purchase, or a person like @rohit

outbox_tools.name: list_outbox
outbox_tools.title: List Outbox
outbox_tools.description: List the latest messages in the outbox.

limit.description: how many of the latest messages
